description: Flexible with my program / ideas and always willing to readjust #selflove #selfmastery #selfdiscovery
transcript: I readjust my program based on what my needs are in that moment. The more that I prioritize being flexible, I allow people, places, and things to be a mere image of my internal world. And I'm able to see myself from a different angle and a different perspective. And the more that I'm able to see myself, I understand that I do not have to control anything. I understand that everything is temporary. Everything is on its way out the door, and it is important for me to allow those things to move through, but enjoy them in the process and to be flexible with them.
